facts.value: An internship will provide you with real world experiences with writing in a professional setting. An internship awards academic credit for supervised work experience that is specifically related to your university education.
The work must provide enough work to justify the registered credits, a job supervisor capable of mentoring the intern, and learning opportunities.

An internship will provide you with a better idea of what you can do with a degree in English, and it will help smooth the transition between school and work. The experience will also help you know how to market your skills after graduation.
